import asyncio

full_text = ""
for offset in range(0, 27546, 3000):
    chunk = await CONTEXT.read(offset, 3000)
    full_text += chunk

# Look at the test code that's failing to understand what it expects
# Find "test_should_process_parsed_cli_arguments" in the full text
import re

# Find the full test function
for m in re.finditer(r'test_should_process_parsed_cli_arguments.*?(?=\n\S)', full_text, re.DOTALL):
    print(m.group()[:2000])
    print("---")

# Look for what's in the STATUS.json
for m in re.finditer(r'STATUS\.json.*?({.*?})', full_text, re.DOTALL):
    print(f"STATUS: {m.group(1)}")
    print("---")

# Check what the final message said
idx = full_text.find("[final message]")
if idx != -1:
    end = full_text.find("\n[path]", idx)
    if end == -1:
        end = idx + 2000
    print(f"Final message at {idx}:")
    print(full_text[idx:end][:1500])
    print("---")

# Check the gradings
for m in re.finditer(r'Verifier verdict.*?(?=\n\[|\n\n|$)', full_text):
    print(f"Verifier: {m.group()}")
    
print("\n\nCheckpoints:")
for m in re.finditer(r'\[checkpoint.*?\].*?(?=\n\[|\Z)', full_text):
    print(m.group()[:200])
